Marshall & Dominguez LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 281-555-1704
Letter of Representation
December 21, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1276
Our client: Dakota Jones
Date of loss: December 1, 2024
Dear Claims Representative:
I write on behalf of our client regarding injuries sustained in a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle
was changing lanes. Our client was driving lawfully when the other driver moved into the lane and made contact with
the side of the client's vehicle. Our client has since sought medical treatment for injuries that are still being evaluated,
and the full impact on work and daily life is continuing to develop.
Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. If you
need to speak with our client about any aspect of the claim, we ask that you first arrange that through our firm.
We also request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage limits of every policy that may apply to the
insured driver, including any excess or umbrella coverage, so that we can assess the claim properly.
Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, recorded
statements, claim notes, telematics or dashcam data, repair estimates, and any vehicle or property involved in the
collision. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or otherwise lost while the calim is open.
Sincerely,
Kyle Sanders
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
